title: PROSE Template Mini-Cloud
description: Public-safe registry for reusable PROSE document templates. The canonical repository manifest remains the primary source, while extension packs can be added without rewriting the core catalog.

extensions.title: Daily Checklist
extensions.description: A clean daily planning checklist with top priorities, task tracking, appointments, follow-up, notes, and an end-of-day review.

extensions.title: Reading Response
extensions.description: A reading response separating summary, supporting details, analysis, connections, questions, and reflection.

extensions.title: Study Guide
extensions.description: A flexible study guide for targets, concepts, vocabulary, practice, retrieval, weak areas, and next actions.

extensions.title: Academic Notes
extensions.description: A structured note sheet with an essential question, cue-and-note table, important details, questions, summary, and next step.

extensions.title: Seminar Discussion Guide
extensions.description: A seminar preparation and reflection guide with questions, support, discussion norms, and post-discussion reflection.

extensions.title: Problem Set
extensions.description: A cross-disciplinary problem-set structure emphasizing visible reasoning, verification, transfer, and reflection.

extensions.title: Assessment Rubric
extensions.description: A reusable rubric with criteria, performance descriptors, weighting, overall feedback, and learner response.

extensions.title: Student Learning Reflection
extensions.description: A learner reflection connecting goals, evidence of learning, strengths, challenges, feedback, revision, and the next goal.

extensions.title: Peer Review
extensions.description: A respectful peer-review structure focused on purpose, strengths, clarity, support, questions, and one high-value revision.

extensions.title: Project Reflection
extensions.description: A project reflection covering goals, process, learning, challenges, outcome, improvement, and transfer.

futurePacks.purpose: Subject, grade-level, academic, research, publishing, and professional template packs may be registered here without exposing private runtime architecture.
